description: Rust is a language that checks many memory mistakes before a program runs. It is used for tools and fast systems. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install stable Rust. Save each example as lesson.rs, run rustc lesson.rs, then run the created program.
versionNote: Examples use stable Rust with the 2021 edition or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Pick a value with if with Rust
Handle a missing value with Rust
learningObjectives: Count with a range with Rust
Read without taking ownership with Rust
